test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Identify the correct passive voice sentence from the passage:

options.text: The fire brigades fought the fire bravely.
A large part of the market was destroyed.
The strong wind helped the fire.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the sentence receives the action instead of performing it. The formula is: **Subject + Form of 'to be' + Past Participle**.
 
• In **Option 2**, the sentence is: *"A large part of the market was destroyed."*
 
• The subject "A large part of the market" is the recipient of the destruction.
 
• The verb "was destroyed" consists of the auxiliary verb "was" (past tense of 'to be') and the past participle "destroyed."
 
• The performer of the action (the fire) is omitted, which is a common characteristic of the passive voice when the cause is known from the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A large part of the market was destroyed."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The fire brigades fought the fire bravely." – This is **active voice**; the subject (fire brigades) performed the action (fought).
 
• **Option 3: **"The strong wind helped the fire." – This is **active voice**; the subject (strong wind) performed the action (helped).
 
• **Option 4: **"Authorities are investigating the cause." – This is **active voice** in the present continuous tense; the subject (authorities) is performing the action (investigating).
